meta.name: brief-generator
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "create an influencer brief" or "write a campaign brief"; produces a structured creator brief with deliverables, key messages, creative direction, timeline, disclosure rules, and compensation terms. Not for choosing how to split spend across creators — use budget-optimizer.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成结构化的创作者简报，包含交付物、关键信息和时间线
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速为创作者或网红撰写一份专业的合作简报
copy.tagline_en: Generate a structured creator brief with deliverables, key messages, and timeline
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly write a professional collaboration brief for creators or influencers

howto.what: Claude 会根据你提供的活动信息，自动生成一份结构完整的创作者简报，包含交付物、关键信息、创意方向、时间表、披露规则和报酬条款。简报会保存到指定位置。
howto.when: 当你要求“创建一份创作者简报”或“写一份活动简报”时触发。也适用于为特定平台（如TikTok、Instagram）生成简报。

say.text: 帮我创建一份TikTok简报，推广我们的新有机蛋白粉。
say.note: Claude会收集活动细节并生成完整简报。

say.text: 写一份Instagram和YouTube的简报，针对新品发布活动。
say.note: Claude会生成多平台简报，包含平台特定要求。

howto.what_en: Claude generates a structured creator brief with deliverables, key messages, creative direction, timeline, disclosure rules, and compensation terms based on campaign info you provide. The brief is saved to a specified location.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "create an influencer brief" or "write a campaign brief." Also fires for platform-specific briefs like TikTok, Instagram, or YouTube.

say_en.text: Create a TikTok brief for our new organic protein powder.
say_en.note: Claude will gather details and produce a complete brief.

say_en.text: Write an Instagram and YouTube brief for a product launch campaign.
say_en.note: Claude will generate multi-platform briefs with platform-specific requirements.
